title: spec_deactivated event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. Records a governed active-to-draft demotion (caws specs deactivate), the inverse of spec_activated. Distinct from spec_closed: closing asserts the work concluded and writes a resolution, so it is the wrong exit for a spec that was activated by mistake or whose slice has not started. Deactivation asserts nothing about outcomes — it returns the spec to the editable draft state and writes no resolution or closure_notes. Refused for a spec bound to a worktree: once work has actually started, the one-way property of active is load-bearing.

previous_lifecycle_state.description: The lifecycle state the spec held before deactivation (always active; other states are refused by deactivateSpec).

reason.description: Optional operator-supplied reason for demoting the spec (e.g. 'activated against the wrong id'). Recorded on the event only — deactivation never writes closure_notes, because it makes no claim about the work.

cleared_terminal_fields.description: Terminal close-only fields removed from the body during demotion. Normally empty: reopen already strips them on the closed-to-active leg. Non-empty when a spec reached active still carrying closure residue, which the demoted draft must not keep.
